rules.statement: A vendor who receives formal notice to warrant and defend his title may either take part in the suit, suffer the purchaser to appoint him procurator in rem suam, or request transfer from defendant to plaintiff under section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a vendor receives formal notice calling on him to warrant and defend his title to a property sold by him, he may either take part in the suit against the trespasser in order to prevent collusion, or he may suffer the purchaser to appoint him procurator in rem suam and take the conduct of the action into his own hands, or if he is made a defendant in the action he may ask, under section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code, that he be transferred from the position of a defendant to that of a plaintiff.

meta.parties: Ahamado Lebbe v. Maris Appu Et Al
